'''''Hainardia''''' is a genus of coastal plants in the [[Poaceae|grass family]], native to the [[Mediterranean Basin]].<ref>Greuter, Werner Rodolfo 1967.  Boissiera. Memoires du Conservatoire de Botanique et de l'Institut de Botanique Systématique de l'Université de Genève 13: 178</ref>

The only known species is '''''Hainardia cylindrica''''', known by several common names, including '''barbgrass''',<ref>{{PLANTS|id=HAINA|taxon=Hainardia|accessdate=19 January 2016}}</ref> '''one-glumed hard-grass''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007 |accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> and '''thintail'''. It is native to the [[Mediterranean]] and to nearby regions from [[Madeira]] and the [[Canary Islands]] east to [[Crimea]] and [[Iran]]. It is also reportedly naturalized in coastal regions in scattered locales in [[Australia]], [[New Zealand]], the [[United States]] ([[California|CA]] [[Oregon|OR]] [[Texas|TX]] [[Louisiana|LA]] [[South Carolina|SC]]),<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://bonap.net/MapGallery/County/Hainardia%20cylindrica.png|title=Biota of North America Program 2013 county distribution map}}</ref> [[Baja California]], and temperate [[South America]] ([[Brazil]], [[Uruguay]], [[Argentina]], [[Chile]]).<ref name=s/><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Hainardia|title=Genere Hainardia - Flora Italiana|website=luirig.altervista.org}}</ref>

''Hainardia cylindrica'' is an annual grass of [[salt marsh]]es and [[estuary|estuaries]], thriving in saline and alkaline soils in aquatic habitats. It has a branching stem reaching a maximum height near half a meter. The thready leaves are ribbed and rough to the touch on the upper surfaces. The top few centimeters of the stem is made up of a cylindrical [[inflorescence]] with each spikelet embedded into it and dividing it into segments which can break off.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/cgi-bin/get_JM_treatment.pl?8738,9040,9041|title=UC/JEPS: Jepson Manual treatment for HAINARDIA cylindrica|website=ucjeps.berkeley.edu}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://plants.usda.gov/plant-profile?symbol=HACY|title=Plants Profile for Hainardia cylindrica (barbgrass)|website=plants.usda.gov}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Hainardia_cylindrica&type=treatment|title=Grass Manual Treatment|access-date=2008-03-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110611141314/http://herbarium.usu.edu/webmanual/info2.asp?name=Hainardia_cylindrica&type=treatment|archive-date=2011-06-11|url-status=dead}}</ref>
